internalNote: Built directly from wisconsin_harmony_extraction_1.csv, a real per-song extraction Kevin provided (24 songs, pages 19-46), rather than freshly researched. Edition year confirmed by Kevin as 1992, matching the existing Library Work record - individual songs' own copyright notices in the source data range 1988-1991, which is ordinary: a compilation's songs are necessarily written before the book itself is published, not a discrepancy to reconcile. compiler here ("James Philip Page") uses the fuller name that appears repeatedly in the source data's own copyright notices, rather than the existing Work record's shorter "James Page".
